lines.en: label bathhouse5:
scene ioyuki1
I show up at the bathhouse to find Io happily humming to herself and scrubbing away at the floor with a brush basically the same size as her.
lines.zh: 我来到澡堂，发现 Io 正愉快地哼着歌，用一把几乎和她一样大的刷子擦着地板。

lines.en: There’s no one else around at the moment (That I can see, at least) and the volume from some sports broadcast is turned up loud enough that she doesn’t hear me enter.
lines.zh: 眼下周围没有别人（至少我看到的范围内没有），某个体育节目转播的音量开得老大，大得她没听见我进来。

lines.en: It looks like she’s in a good mood, though.
lines.zh: 不过她看起来心情不错。

lines.en: I never really know what I’m going to be getting into when I go see her, but at least I’ve been given a sign of good things to come in that childish smile of hers.
lines.zh: 我从来不知道去找她会撞上什么状况，但至少她那孩子气的笑容给了我一个好兆头。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: To be fair, I’m half-expecting her to make everything awkward and uncomfortable the second our conversation starts.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我已经半预料到对话一开口，她就会把气氛弄得尴尬又不舒服。

lines.en: She’s quite good at that, if I’ve learned anything about her by now.
lines.zh: 如果说我到现在对她有所了解的话，那她可是相当擅长这个。

lines.en: Which I think I have.
lines.zh: 我想我确实了解到了。

lines.en: Again, probably.
lines.zh: 再说一次，大概吧。

lines.en: : So is staring at [high_school] girls a hobby of yours or something?
lines.zh: : 所以说，盯着 [high_school] 女生看算是你的爱好之类的吗？

lines.en: : This is the second time I’ve caught you just looking at me and not saying anything.
lines.zh: : 这已经是第二次被我抓到你光盯着我看、一句话都不说了。

lines.en: : I should have known you saw me walk in. The volume of the TV deceived me into thinking you somehow didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我早该知道你看见我进来了。电视的音量骗了我，让我以为你不知怎么没看见。

lines.en: scene ioyuki6
: Of course I saw you. You’re impossible to miss.
lines.zh: : 我当然看见了。想看不见你都难。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many people of your size come in here? Like, none.
lines.zh: : 你知道有多少你这种体型的人会来这儿吗？基本为零。

lines.en: : Well, obviously at least one. But you get what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 好吧，显然至少有一个。不过你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Yes, I am tall. Thank you for noticing.
lines.zh: : 对，我个子高。谢谢你的关注。

lines.en: : So, here to hang out with me? Or are you actually going to use the bath this time?
lines.zh: : 那么，你是来陪我的？还是这次真打算泡澡？

lines.en: : If it’s the latter, you’re going to have to wait a little while. I’ve got someone in the men’s section right now.
lines.zh: : 要是后者的话，你得等一会儿。男浴区现在有人。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m not {i}opposed{/i} to sharing, but I kind of just came here for you anyway.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我并不{i}反对{/i}与人共用，不过我本来就是冲着你来的。

lines.en: : Well good, because the girl in there doesn’t really like people intruding on her private time.
lines.zh: : 那正好，因为里面那位姑娘不太喜欢别人打扰她的私人时间。

lines.en: : Now that I have confirmed it is a woman, I would like to reinforce that I {i}really{/i} do not mind sharing.
lines.zh: : 既然我已经确认里面是位女性，我想再强调一次，我{i}真的{/i}不介意共用。

lines.en: scene ioyuki3
: Sensei, I literally {i}just{/i} told you she likes being left alone.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我{i}刚刚{/i}才跟你说过她喜欢一个人待着。

lines.en: : Just because I like you and I’ve seen your penis doesn’t mean I’ll let you walk all over me.
lines.zh: : 就算我喜欢你、也见过你的鸡巴，也不代表我会让你骑到我头上。

lines.en: : Then you’re already far too advanced for me to comprehend. That combination normally works wonders.
lines.zh: : 那你先进到我已经理解不了的程度了。那种组合通常都能创造奇迹。

lines.en: : You know, I’m glad that you’re starting to open up to me the way I open up to you...but lengthy conversations about your sexcapades are not really a thing I’m interested in.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我很高兴你开始像我对你敞开心扉那样对我敞开心扉……不过长篇大论聊你的性冒险，实在不是我感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: : Then what {i}are{/i} you interested in? Besides scrubbing the floors of a bathhouse, I mean.
lines.zh: : 那你{i}到底{/i}对什么感兴趣？我是说，除了擦澡堂的地板之外。

lines.en: scene ioyuki4
: This isn’t a hobby. I do this to make money and help my aunt.
lines.zh: : 这不是爱好。我干这个是为了挣钱，帮我姑姑。

lines.en: : My real hobbies are stuff like...baseball and...camping.
lines.zh: : 我真正的爱好是……棒球之类的……还有露营。

lines.en: : Actually, I’ve got quite a few hobbies now that I think of it.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我的爱好其实还挺多的。

lines.en: : I also like hiking...and building stuff...and those cool serial killer documentaries they have on Netflix.
lines.zh: : 我还喜欢徒步……动手做东西……还有 Netflix 上那些很酷的连环杀手纪录片。

lines.en: : And not a single “girly” thing to be found.
lines.zh: : 而且找不出一件“女孩子气”的东西。

lines.en: scene ioyuki5
: Uhh...isn’t that a little sexist?
lines.zh: : 呃……这话说得是不是有点性别歧视？

lines.en: : You’re not gonna make fun of me for not being into the same sort of stuff Uta is into, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会因为我喜欢的东西和 Uta 不一样就取笑我吧？

lines.en: : Oh, not at all. If anything, your interests are easier for me to understand than hers.
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对不会。要说的话，你的兴趣比她的好懂得多。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of refreshing seeing someone who’s into such...normal things.
lines.zh: : 看到有人喜欢这么……普通的东西，其实挺让人耳目一新的。

lines.en: : Putting it that way just makes me sound boring...
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，我就显得很无聊了……

lines.en: : Where are you trying to go with this?
lines.zh: : 你到底想说什么？

lines.en: : No clue.
lines.zh: : 不知道。

lines.en: : How’d you get into all of that, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你是怎么喜欢上这些的？

lines.en: scene ioyuki6
: It’s just what I’m into, you know? There doesn’t have to be some long backstory about why I like baseball. I just...like baseball.
lines.zh: : 我就是喜欢，你懂吧？喜欢棒球不需要什么长长的背景故事。我就是……喜欢棒球。

lines.en: : It’s that simple.
lines.zh: : 就这么简单。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I was just opening up a window for you to talk more so I don’t feel pressured to think up a conversation topic.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。我只是给你开个口子让你多说点，这样我就不用硬想话题了。

lines.en: scene ioyuki5
: It’s been five minutes and you’re already struggling with that? You’re even worse than me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 才五分钟你就撑不住了？你比我还要差劲，Sensei。

lines.en: : True, but at least I try.
lines.zh: : 没错，不过至少我还会努力。

lines.en: scene ioyuki7
: Heheh~ True.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 也是。

lines.en: : At least you try.
lines.zh: : 至少你还会努力。

lines.en: : Io! Can you spot me some of that conditioner I like?
lines.zh: : Io！能不能给我拿点我喜欢的那款护发素？

lines.en: scene ioyuki8
: You know, the one in the black bottle that smells like-
lines.zh: : 就是那个黑瓶子的，闻起来像——

lines.en: scene ioyuki9
: Oh.
: What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I was about to ask you the same question.
lines.zh: : 我正想问你同样的问题。

lines.en: : We’re out of the one you like but we should have more by Monday.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢的那款用完了，不过周一应该会补货。

lines.en: : Want me to get my personal bottle from upstairs for you? It’s basically the same thing.
lines.zh: : 要我上楼把我自己那瓶拿给你吗？基本是一样的东西。

lines.en: scene ioyuki10
: Nah. I’ll survive without it. No need to go out of your way for me.
lines.zh: : 不用。没有它我也死不了。不用特意为我跑一趟。

lines.en: : You sure? I don’t mind if it’s for you.
lines.zh: : 你确定？为你我是愿意的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m good. No worries.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真不用。别担心。

lines.en: : I take it you two are familiar with one another?
lines.zh: : 看来你们两位互相认识？

lines.en: scene ioyuki11
: This is the girl I was talking about before- the one who likes being left alone.
lines.zh: : 这就是我之前说的那个姑娘——喜欢一个人待着的那个。

lines.en: : But I take it you two...know each other in some way?
lines.zh: : 不过我看你们俩……应该也认识吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. He’s boning my daughter.
lines.zh: : 嗯。他在搞我女儿。

lines.en: scene ioyuki12
: Uhh...come again?
lines.zh: : 呃……你说什么？

lines.en: : Okay, hold on a second. I am not {i}boning your daughter.{/i} She’s just a student in my class and I’m helping her find a job.
lines.zh: : 好，等一下。我没有{i}搞你女儿{/i}。她只是我班上的一个学生，我在帮她找工作。

lines.en: I would absolutely bone her if given the opportunity, though.
lines.zh: 不过要是有机会，我绝对会搞她。

lines.en: But I’d bone pretty much anyone if given the opportunity and-
lines.zh: 可只要有我机会我大概谁都会搞，而且——

lines.en: This is not a thing I should be thinking right now.
lines.zh: 这不是我现在该想的事。

lines.en: : Wait wait wait wait wait. Yuki’s daughter is in our class?
lines.zh: : 等等等等等等。Yuki 的女儿在我们班上？

lines.en: scene ioyuki13
: So I hear.
lines.zh: : 听说是这样。

lines.en: : Smartass lookin’ girl. Probably wearin’ that same old long-ass skirt I used to wear when I was in[school].
lines.zh: : 一副自以为是的丫头。大概还穿着我当年在[school]时穿的那种长得要命的裙子。

lines.en: : Long skirt...
lines.zh: : 长裙子……

lines.en: : Wait, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 等等，Yumi？

lines.en: : Holy shit, how did I not realize this?
lines.zh: : 我靠，我怎么没早点反应过来？

lines.en: : Probably better off not tellin’ her we’re close. She’ll just get pissed off and threaten to beat your ass or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 最好别让她知道我们关系好。她会气炸，然后威胁要揍你一顿什么的。

lines.en: : Yup, definitely sounds like Yumi.
lines.zh: : 嗯，确实像 Yumi 会干的事。

lines.en: scene ioyuki14
: Yeah. I’m sure you know all about her, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你肯定对她了如指掌，对吧？

lines.en: : As her teacher, not her lover.
lines.zh: : 是作为她的老师，不是她的情人。

lines.en: : I’m gonna stop you two right there since I feel like this is skirting into uneasy territory.
lines.zh: : 我得在这儿打断你们两位，因为我觉得这话题正在往让人不安的方向滑。

lines.en: scene ioyuki15
: Hah...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哈……是啊。

lines.en: : No use talkin’ about that shit right now.
lines.zh: : 现在聊这些也没用。

lines.en: : Still weird findin’ out you’re in the same class as my kid, though.
lines.zh: : 不过发现你和我家孩子同班，还是挺怪的。

lines.en: : Knew you switched[school]s but didn’t think a coincidence like that was gonna pop up.
lines.zh: : 知道你转了[school]，但没想到会冒出这种巧合。

lines.en: : I’m more interested in whatever coincidence brought {i}you two{/i} together.
lines.zh: : 我更感兴趣的是，是什么样的巧合把{i}你们俩{/i}凑到一起的。

lines.en: : It’s like a weird little family reunion we’ve got going on right now. Just none of us are related and one of us is naked.
lines.zh: : 简直像一场奇怪的小型家庭聚会。只不过我们之间没有血缘关系，而且其中一个是裸着的。

lines.en: : Not naked...Got a towel on.
lines.zh: : 不是裸着……裹着浴巾呢。

lines.en: : We bumped into each other at a ramen shop one day.
lines.zh: : 我们有一天在一家拉面店撞上了。

lines.en: : And then again at...that same ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 然后又……在同一家拉面店又撞上了。

lines.en: : I don’t go many places, alright? Give me a fuckin' break.
lines.zh: : 我不怎么出门，行吗？给我他妈的留点余地。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Okay. So you’re not really {i}friends{/i}, just acquaintances.
lines.zh: : 哦，行行。所以你们算不上{i}朋友{/i}，只是认识而已。

lines.en: : Something like that, sure.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，嗯。

lines.en: scene ioyuki16
: Which means you probably haven’t seen {i}that{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 也就是说你大概还没见过{i}那个{/i}。

lines.en: : That?
lines.zh: : 那个？

lines.en: : You have any idea what she’s talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 你知道她在说什么吗？

lines.en: : How would I know? You’re the one with {i}that{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道？有{i}那个{/i}的人是你。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what {i}that{/i} is. How am I supposed to know I actually have it?
lines.zh: : 我连{i}那个{/i}是什么都不知道。我怎么会知道自己身上有？

lines.en: scene ioyuki17
: Yuki! Show him your tattoo!
lines.zh: : Yuki！给他看看你的纹身！

lines.en: : Ooooooh, {i}that{/i}.
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢，{i}那个{/i}啊。

lines.en: : Again, Yuki and I are hardly acquainted and there’s no way she’d-
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我和 Yuki 根本算不上熟，她不可能——

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 行啊。

lines.en: : Long as I can do it in the men’s locker room and not out here in the co-ed one.
lines.zh: : 只要能在男更衣室里看，别在这种男女共用的地方就行。

lines.en: : Not really a thing I want most people seeing.
lines.zh: : 这东西我不太想让大多数人看到。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: scene ioyuki18
: Yay!
lines.zh: : 好耶！

lines.en: : What’s wrong, man?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，老兄？

lines.en: : You ain’t the type to get all nervous and shit when a girl takes her clothes off, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不像是那种女生一脱衣服就紧张得要死的人啊？

lines.en: : Quite the opposite, actually.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。

lines.en: : That’s kind of just as bad.
lines.zh: : 那也差不多一样糟。

lines.en: : Just don’t touch me and we’re good.
lines.zh: : 别碰我就行。

lines.en: : It’s on my back so it’s not like I’m showin’ you my tits or anything. Just totally normal shit.
lines.zh: : 在我背上，又不是要给你看我的奶子什么的。就是再正常不过的东西。

lines.en: : Woo! Let’s get you two into the locker room! It's game time!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！把你们俩弄进更衣室去！好戏开场了！

lines.en: scene black
Io locks the entrance to the bathhouse so no one can come in and then immediately shows us to the men’s locker room.
lines.zh: Io 把澡堂的入口锁上，免得有人进来，然后立刻把我们带到男更衣室。

lines.en: And when I say “shows us to” I mean she gets behind me and pushes me inside.
lines.zh: 而我说“带到”的意思是，她绕到我身后把我推了进去。

lines.en: I’m not sure why. I would have gladly walked in on my own.
lines.zh: 我不知道她为什么这么做。我自己走进去也完全乐意。

lines.en: Even if it’s just from behind, the chance to see Yumi’s mom without clothes on is an opportunity I would never miss out on.
lines.zh: 哪怕只能从后面看，能看见不穿衣服的 Yumi 她妈，这种机会我绝不会放过。

lines.en: scene ioyuki19
: Remember, touch me and I’ll cut your fucking hands off.
lines.zh: : 记住，敢碰我，我就把你他妈的手剁了。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : That’s right. Only {i}I’m{/i} allowed to touch Yuki.
lines.zh: : 没错。只有{i}我{/i}能碰 Yuki。

lines.en: : Io ain’t allowed to touch me either.
lines.zh: : 也不准 Io 碰我。

lines.en: : I’m going to anyway. Watch.
lines.zh: : 我偏要碰。看着吧。

lines.en: : Let’s just get this shit over with.
lines.zh: : 赶紧把这事儿了结了吧。

lines.en: : It ain’t even that impressive.
lines.zh: : 又没什么好看的。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki turns around and begins to slowly lower her towel.
lines.zh: Yuki 转过身，开始慢慢往下拉浴巾。

lines.en: It isn’t until it gets halfway down her back that I {i}really{/i} notice how pale she is.
lines.zh: 直到浴巾落到她背中间，我才{i}真正{/i}注意到她有多苍白。

lines.en: Paired with the fluorescent light, she’s almost like a ghost.
lines.zh: 配上荧光灯，她几乎像个幽灵。

lines.en: scene ioyuki20
Her towel stops just as it reaches her ass (An anticlimactic finale, I know) and I’m suddenly faced with a Yakuza-esque tattoo taking up her entire back.
lines.zh: 浴巾停在她屁股上方（我知道，这个收尾挺扫兴的），紧接着，一幅占据她整个后背的黑道风格纹身突然出现在我面前。

lines.en: I’m sure this is part of the reason why she takes up this side to herself whenever she’s here.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这就是她每次来都要独自霸占这一边的原因之一。

lines.en: There aren't a lot of Japanese people who'd be willing to...overlook something like this.
lines.zh: 没有多少日本人愿意……对这种东西视而不见。

lines.en: But I-
lines.zh: 可我——

lines.en: : I think it’s-
lines.zh: : 我觉得它——

lines.en: : SO COOL!
lines.zh: : 太酷了！

lines.en: scene ioyuki21
Io appears before I’m able to finish my train of thought and places her hand directly on Yuki’s back.
lines.zh: 我还没来得及把话说完，Io 就冒了出来，直接把手按在 Yuki 的背上。

lines.en: I’ve gotta say, for someone who doesn’t like girls, she seems to be handling her, of all people, rather well.
lines.zh: 不得不说，作为一个不喜欢女生的人，她对付起偏偏是 Yuki 这样的人来倒挺有一套。

lines.en: But I guess Yuki isn’t exactly the most feminine person around.
lines.zh: 不过我想 Yuki 也算不上是最有女人味的人。

lines.en: : Hah...
: You’re lucky I like you, Io.
lines.zh: : 算你走运，我喜欢你，Io。

lines.en: scene ioyuki22
: Sensei! Isn’t this like, the coolest thing you’ve ever seen?
lines.zh: : Sensei！这难道不是你见过最酷的东西吗？

lines.en: : The first time I saw it was actually on the camera and I was so impressed that I ran out to meet her in the bath.
lines.zh: : 我第一次看到它其实是通过监控摄像头，当时太震撼了，我直接跑出去在浴室里找她。

lines.en: : Fuckin’ horrible first impression.
lines.zh: : 真他妈是最糟的第一印象。

lines.en: : Oh, I was the absolute worst. I know.
lines.zh: : 哦，我当时是最差劲的。我知道。

lines.en: : But it was so awesome that I couldn’t stay away.
lines.zh: : 可它实在太酷了，我根本忍不住。

lines.en: : Well I’d be more than happy to give it to ya if that were possible.
lines.zh: : 要是能给你，我倒是很乐意。

lines.en: : Shit’s a fuckin curse, if ya ask me.
lines.zh: : 要我说，这玩意儿就是个诅咒。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you think I’d look good with a tattoo like that?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你觉得我纹一个这样的好看吗？

lines.en: : I’d have to see you without a shirt on first to figure that out.
lines.zh: : 那我得先看你脱了上衣的样子才能判断。

lines.en: : Hey. Don’t forget I’m still here.
lines.zh: : 喂。别忘了我还在这儿。

lines.en: : If you two are gonna fuck, go do it on the girl’s side. I still need to take a bath and I don't wanna watch that shit.
lines.zh: : 你们俩要是想干，去女浴那边干。我还得泡澡，可不想看那种东西。

lines.en: : I think I want one but like, not as big as Yuki’s.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我想要一个，不过别像 Yuki 的那么大。

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be on my back, either. Anywhere would be fine.
lines.zh: : 也不一定要在背上。哪儿都行。

lines.en: : Oh! We should get them together!
lines.zh: : 哦！我们应该一起去纹！

lines.en: : Sensei, let’s go get tattoos!
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们去纹身吧！

lines.en: : Uhh...Yeah, I think I’m good.
lines.zh: : 呃……行，我看还是算了。

lines.en: : Aight, time to beat it, you two. Still dry as fuck and not feelin' it.
lines.zh: : 行了，你们俩该滚了。我身上还干得要死，一点没泡爽。

lines.en: : Kinda ruinin’ my me-time right now.
lines.zh: : 你们现在有点在毁我的独处时间。

lines.en: : Fine, fine. We’re leaving.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我们走。

lines.en: scene ioyuki23
: Thanks for showing Sensei your tattoo, Yuki!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你给 Sensei 看你的纹身，Yuki！

lines.en: : I know how long it’s been since you’ve taken your clothes off in front of a man and-
lines.zh: : 我知道你已经很久没在男人面前脱过衣服了——

lines.en: : Get...out...
: Yes ma’am!
lines.zh: : 遵命，女士！

lines.en: scene black
Io quickly scurries out of the room, picking up her floor brush as she does so.
lines.zh: Io 飞快地窜出房间，顺手抄起了她的地板刷。

lines.en: I follow behind her and the two of us quickly return to our earlier conversation once we’re in the lobby again.
lines.zh: 我跟在她后面，一回到大厅，我们俩很快就重新拾起刚才的话题。

lines.en: She goes back to talking about her hobbies and how much she apparently likes body art and-
lines.zh: 她又聊起她的爱好，还有她显然有多喜欢人体艺术之类的——

lines.en: After another thirty minutes of that, Yuki rejoins us.
lines.zh: 这么又过了三十分钟，Yuki 重新加入了我们。

lines.en: scene ioyuki24
: You’re still here? Don’t you have like, shit to do or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你还在这儿？你不是应该有……别的事要忙吗？

lines.en: : Yumi have a job yet?
lines.zh: : Yumi 找到工作了吗？

lines.en: : No shit to do and I’m not sure what Yumi is up to right now.
lines.zh: : 没有别的事要忙，我也不知道 Yumi 现在在干什么。

lines.en: : Well that makes two of us then.
lines.zh: : 那我们俩倒是半斤八两。

lines.en: scene ioyuki25
: Uhh...
: Listen.
lines.zh: : 听着。

lines.en: : I know this will probably sound fucking dumb or whatever but like...
lines.zh: : 我知道这话听起来大概会他妈的很蠢之类的，不过……

lines.en: : If you’d want to meet up at the ramen shop again sometime and talk about her...or other shit, that would be cool.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意改天在拉面店再碰个面，聊聊她……或者别的什么，那就挺好的。

lines.en: : I kinda still owe you for payin’ for me the first time...so it would be on me.
lines.zh: : 我多少还欠你上次替我付的钱……所以这次我请。

lines.en: : Just don't buy anything fuckin' expensive. I'm not made of cash.
lines.zh: : 就是别点什么他妈的贵东西。我又不是印钞机。

lines.en: Yuki proceeds to tell me her phone number and I give her mine in return.
lines.zh: Yuki 接着报出了她的电话号码，我也把自己的给了她。

lines.en: We don’t make any concrete plans or anything so I guess I’ll just...call her whenever I call her.
lines.zh: 我们没有定下什么具体的计划，所以我想……什么时候想打就什么时候打吧。

lines.en: I have to say, this is definitely not how I envisioned myself acquiring her number.
lines.zh: 我得说，这绝对不是我想象中拿到她号码的方式。

lines.en: Hell, I didn’t envision that at all, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我压根就没想象过。

lines.en: But it’s a thing I have now, so I might as well get to know her.
lines.zh: 不过既然已经有了，我也不妨去了解了解她。

lines.en: $ yukinumber = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Yuki’s number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你获得了 Yuki 的号码！{/i}

lines.en: scene ioyuki26
After entering my number into her phone, Yuki nods at Io and heads outside...
lines.zh: 把我的号码存进她的手机后，Yuki 朝 Io 点了点头，走了出去……

lines.en: : So...Yuki, huh?
lines.zh: : 那么……Yuki 啊？

lines.en: : You ever gonna call her?
lines.zh: : 你会给她打电话吗？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : You don't have a problem with that, do you?
lines.zh: : 你对此没意见吧？

lines.en: : Why would I have a problem? She gave it to you so you can do whatever you want with it.
lines.zh: : 我为什么会介意？号码是她给你的，你想怎么用都行。

lines.en: : Call her, don’t call her. Not up to me.
lines.zh: : 打不打都行。不归我管。

lines.en: : She’s not...a bad person or anything. I like her a lot.
lines.zh: : 她不是……坏人什么的。我很喜欢她。

lines.en: : So it would...only make sense if you liked her too.
lines.zh: : 所以……你会喜欢上她也很正常。

lines.en: scene ioyuki27
: Sorry. I’m probably being weird. Am I being weird?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我大概有点怪。我是不是很怪？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m definitely being weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确实是怪了。

lines.en: : Let’s just go back to talking about normal stuff again.
lines.zh: : 我们还是聊回正常的话题吧。

lines.en: scene black
At her behest, Io and I return to standard banter and, before long, it’s time for her to go on break.
lines.zh: 在她的要求下，我和 Io 又回到了平常的斗嘴模式；没过多久，就到了她休息的时间。

lines.en: I offer to walk around the city with her for a little while to help kill time, but she adamantly refuses going out in the cold as she doesn’t want to get dressed.
lines.zh: 我提议陪她在城里逛一会儿打发时间，可她坚决不肯，说不想穿衣服再跑到外面挨冻。

lines.en: I don’t blame her. Getting dressed is horrible.
lines.zh: 我不怪她。穿衣服这件事糟透了。

lines.en: Wearing pajamas out in public should be socially acceptable. It would solve so many problems.
lines.zh: 穿睡衣出门应该被社会接受才对。那样能解决太多问题了。

lines.en: But that has nothing to do with where I’m going now, which is-
lines.zh: 不过这和我现在要去的地方没关系，也就是——

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 哈。

lines.en: Where am I going again?
lines.zh: 我要去哪儿来着？

lines.en: $ io_love += 1
$ bathhouse5 = True
{i}Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
